C0446.title: Xiangjia Shares Employees Sentenced in First Instance for Embezzling Eggs Worth Over 4 Million Yuan
C0446.summary: In May 2026, the Shimen County court in Hunan issued a first-instance judgment in an occupational embezzlement case. Warehouse keepers at Xiangjia Shares' non-breeding-egg warehouse colluded with purchasers and embezzled eggs by altering outbound quantities, falsifying data, and taking more than was recorded. The value exceeded RMB 4 million, and six defendants received prison terms and fines; the conduct ran from January 2021 to September 2024.
